label: GO step when choosing a2 again after a common a2 trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.9% of mass), only when the policy picks a2 (model_act==2, choice logit < -4.4; equivalent to action==2), and essentially never when the previous trial was a1 or a rare transition (prev_common==0 rate ~0). So it is a repeat-a2-after-common-a2 (or first-trial-in-window) GO signal. A strong, unexplained episode-time dependence: active mostly in ep_trial 3-50 and silent after trial ~60, so the predicate adds ep_trial<55. The value head output is also confined to [7.6, 8.1] when active. Uses only observed variables plus the agent own policy argmax. Never fires at D2, on rewarded D1 inputs, or for a1. Dev: P 0.49, R 0.98, mass recall 0.99; precision is limited because within qualifying a2 streaks it fires on only about half the GO steps, with magnitude decaying across consecutive stays in a pattern I could not capture (not explained by prev_reward or reward).
